en: But please, believe in yourself and keep moving forward. I'm sure the angel will guide you.
I understand... Thank you for speaking with me.
Take care, Rudiere.
You! What have you done to the Holy Mother?!
Rudi... The Demon Stone... has been stolen.
Rudi... Please, protect the world. And be a help to the angel...
Yes, I will... Holy Mother...
You! What are you doing?!
Are you all right? Hang in there!!
Damn it! If only I'd come sooner, this wouldn't have...
The Other Demon Stone
Viper!
Whoa, Rocus? Didn't expect to run into you here.
You... Why are you hiding among the imperial army?!
Whoops... Sorry, I can't play with you today.
I was just passing through. Time for me to scram.
See ya...
Wait!
Out of my way!
Not bad. What is your name?
Move! I've got no business with the likes of you!
Hmph... Are you chasing Viper?
You know him?
I need not answer a man who won't even give his name. I'll only say he is someone who cooperates with us nicely.
Was it the Empire that had him steal the Demon Stone from the Church?
Hahaha, and what if it was?
I'll beat you and take it back.
What a valiant priest. But I have no need to fight you now.
My name is Alberic. We'll meet again, angel's hero.
Damn, there's no end to them...
Healing Hands
The Boy
Thug 1
With this, we'll be rolling in cash!
Thug 2
Yeah, and the guy in our way is taken care of...
What are you doing?!
Whoa, crap! Run for it!
Hey, are you all right?
Did they do this to you? Hang in there, I'll help you right now...
You two, from back then?
Yeah, thanks to you saving that kid, the money we had coming went poof!
You... You kidnapped that child, demanded a ransom, and then tried to kill the kid too?!
Yeah, so what? Kill a brat or two and the world won't change one bit.
What we need is money. Money! With money, you can do anything.
You bastards...!
This army... Ngh... At least the cathedral...
The cathedral... What happened to everyone?
Witch
So there's still a priest who hasn't run.
You... This city...
Hm? You... You must be the angel's hero.
But you're too late. Alone, you're helpless against the Empire's army.
Go on, struggle all you like.
It's no use... I can't do anything alone. Damn...
Wait, Viper! I'll have that Demon Stone back.
Tch.
I'll take it back from you by force if I have to.
Hold on... Don't get so worked up.
I'm no good in a fight.
Besides, trying to take back what you lost on a bet by force? That's low.
Makes a man look cheap.
You swindled it out of me... with your devil's cards!
The cards' power is power. I played that game fair and square.
Shut up! Either hand over the Demon Stone quietly or fight me!
All right... I'll give back the Demon Stone... No violence.
I don't really need a thing like this anyway.
What's wrong? Come and get it.
Hand it over, Viper!
No can do... I changed my mind.
Let's go with violence after all.
Here I come!
Viper's Trap (Won)
Tch, you're strong. Pretty strong.
...But I can't give you the Demon Stone. It's my last bit of fun...
So long!
Viper's Trap (Lost)
Hmph... Not bad.
Well, I'll let you live.
I don't want to lose a gambling buddy.
So long.
＄＄＄＄＄＄, that child over there... Isn't that the beast tamer who appeared in the Forest of the Holy Mother?
He hasn't noticed us? Let's follow him, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
A stone? Don't tell me... the Demon Stone?
This is...
Was that boy... talking to his dead mother?
You! Stay away from my mom!!
...You came to take back the Demon Stone!
I'll never give it back... With this, the lady who gave me power will make my mom well again...
...No one can bring back the dead.
I know that no sorcerer can do it.
Even if you can't believe it... that's the truth...
Sh-shut up! Don't get in my way!
Ion's House (Rocus)
Dead Mother
Stop this pointless act...
Sh-shut up...
I've come for the Demon Stone, Ion.
...Hm? Who are you?
So you're the one who deceived this boy.
I deceived no one. I keep my promises.
Now, Ion, I'll make your mother well again.
So hand over the Demon Stone the Holy Mother had.
Thank you. This is the Demon Stone, all right.
Now, my mom... make her like she was...
Yes, of course. Watch.
Mom...
Get away... Ion! That's not your mother!
Mom...?
No... You're not... my mom...!
Hehe... Oh well... You can go join your mother, Ion.
Aagh...!
Ion...!
You witch! How could you!
Hahahaha.
You...!
Now that I have the Demon Stone, I have no more business here.
Ngh!
Ion... I'll save you with my power...
It's okay... mister... I'm going... to my mom...
Ion... Ion!
Hey, Rocus...
Viper, you've made a fool of me plenty of times.
But I don't like losing without hitting back.
I'll be paying you back for all of it.
Won't pay back your debts, but you'll pay back a grudge, huh...
You really are a good guy...
We sure get along.
Don't get mad. It's a joke.
Well, I guess this is where I bow out. Let's settle this and be done.
Here I come, Rocus.
Viper's End (Won)
Tch... I lost...
You're strong...
I can't finish you off...
Oh, you've finally noticed our friendship... I'm touched.
No... It's because you're not even worth it...
That's harsh... Heh, well... you're right...
But you know... I'm dying here...
This body of mine... was done for anyway...
I wanted to see the end of the world before I died...
Didn't get my wish...
Rocus... come here...
I don't want you to heal me... I just... want you by my side...
Deep Currents
How beautiful... A mysterious woman.
Do you serve the angel too?
Yes. You must be the hero with the healing hands.
That's right, I'm Rocus. Hasn't the angel told you about me?
A hero overflowing with courage and sincerity.
Yes, I've heard about you.
The angel said you were quite a handful.
That angel... feeding such lies to a beautiful girl like you.
Giving in to petty jealousy like that... It makes me doubt the angel's character...
Hehehe...
Honestly, the angel's always...
You haven't changed...
Hm? I believe this is the first time... we've met...
It's just that I once knew someone very much like you, long ago...
Someone like me...?
No, never mind... Please don't worry about it.
I hope we meet again somewhere. Goodbye, Rocus.
Yes, goodbye...
No... not really.
That angel doesn't even count me as one of the heroes...
Meeting the Holy Mother
You've done well to come this far, hero guided by the angel.
...And you are?
I am Diana, who protects this sacred forest. Only the chosen, those who have received the holy blessing, can find their way here...
That's quite a grand story...
It is. What is your name?
Rocus Las Flores.
Rocus Las Flores...? Then are you the current Pope of the Holy Kingdom?
How do you know that? And "the Holy Kingdom" is an old way of putting it...
I see... No one calls it the Holy Kingdom anymore...
I can tell from your bearing. A hero in clerical robes must surely be one who has the healing hands.
It's true that I have the healing hands... but I haven't become Pope.
I see... Rocus, come here.
You look very much like him... the first Pope.
What are you talking about?
I am only saying what I feel...
Rocus... You have power. But you also have doubts...
The enemy will strike there. But hold to your faith, and don't give in to temptation...
You are a hero who fought alongside me... I'm sure you'll be fine.
Somehow... I feel like I understand... what you mean...
I see... I'm glad...
Thank you for the advice.
Rocus, believe in yourself and go on.
What are you doing?!
Who are you?
A child?! Why would you do this...
Get in my way and I'll kill you.
Did you lay a hand on Diana-sama?
Rocus... The Demon Stone... has been stolen.
